<Tip>
**"Sprinklers = 61/15; No Sprinklers = 46/6."** Memorizing these two pairs covers the majority of egress-bonus questions in the LEA. The bonus reflects the roughly $33\%$ increase in safety margin provided by suppression.
</Tip>

 "Swapping values: thinking unsprinklered allows more distance than sprinklered",
 "Applying the 61m bonus to high-hazard (Group G) spaces which may have much tighter restrictions",
 "Forgetting the high-rise threshold (15m height) that triggers mandatory sprinkler installation"
]} />
